part.rationale: The canonical schema splits rows into ShortTermCapitalGainAndLossGrp and LongTermCapitalGainAndLossGrp groups rather than exposing a single 'part' attribute; blueprint should derive part from which group the CapitalGainAndLossAssetGrp row belongs to (indices 2/3 for short-term, 0/1 for long-term) rather than storing it as a separate field.

reporting_category.rationale: The reporting category checkbox (A/B/C or D/E/F) is not represented as a distinct leaf element in the canonical schema; the MeF schema encodes it implicitly through the group/asset structure with no corresponding XSD element in the candidate list.

description_of_property.rationale: No leaf element for property description (e.g., PropertyDescriptionTxt) appears in the closed candidate list; the four candidates are all group-level elements with no label, so no match is possible.

date_acquired.rationale: No leaf element for date acquired (e.g., AcquiredDt) appears in the closed candidate list; all four candidates are group-level elements.

date_sold.rationale: No leaf element for date sold (e.g., SoldDt) appears in the closed candidate list; all four candidates are group-level elements.

proceeds.rationale: No leaf amount element for proceeds (e.g., ProceedsAmt) appears in the closed candidate list; all four candidates are group-level elements.

cost_or_basis.rationale: No leaf amount element for cost or basis (e.g., CostOrOtherBasisAmt) appears in the closed candidate list; all four candidates are group-level elements.

adjustment_code.rationale: No leaf element for adjustment code (e.g., AdjustmentCd) appears in the closed candidate list; all four candidates are group-level elements.

adjustment_amount.rationale: No leaf amount element for adjustment amount (e.g., GainOrLossAdjustmentAmt) appears in the closed candidate list; all four candidates are group-level elements.

gain_or_loss.rationale: No leaf amount element for gain or loss (e.g., GainOrLossAmt) appears in the closed candidate list; all four candidates are group-level elements.

taxpayer_name.rationale: No leaf element for taxpayer name appears in the closed candidate list; header fields are not represented among the four group-level candidates.

taxpayer_ssn.rationale: No leaf element for taxpayer SSN/TIN appears in the closed candidate list; header fields are not represented among the four group-level candidates.
